e.title: One-Year Correlated Chain Ladder
e.summary: Solvency II 合规的一年期相关链梯（MDPI Risks 论文代码）：准备金风险的一年期视角
e.body: One-Year Correlated Chain Ladder 是符合 Solvency II 指引的一年期相关链梯实现（论文《A bayesian internal model for reserve risk: an extension of the Correlated Chain Ladder》发表于 MDPI Risks 8(4):125）：把相关链梯适配到一年期准备金风险视角（Solvency II 的一年期折现与风险边际）。对 RIAA：Solvency II 准备金风险的一年期方法论文代码。与 [[chainladder]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]（一年期视角）、[[profileladder]] 互补。关联 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[solvency2rfr]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：MDPI Risks 8(4):125 论文代码，Solvency II 一年期相关链梯
e.summary_en: Solvency II-compliant one-year correlated chain ladder (MDPI Risks paper code): the one-year view of reserve risk
e.summary_hk: Solvency II 合規的一年期相關鏈梯（MDPI Risks 論文代碼）：準備金風險的一年期視角
e.body_en: One-Year Correlated Chain Ladder is an implementation of the one-year correlated chain ladder compliant with Solvency II guidelines (paper 'A bayesian internal model for reserve risk: an extension of the Correlated Chain Ladder', MDPI Risks 8(4):125): adapting the correlated chain ladder to the one-year view of reserve risk (Solvency II's one-year discounting and risk margins). For RIAA: paper code for the one-year perspective of Solvency II reserve risk. Complements [[chainladder]], [[stochastic-reserving-england]] (one-year view) and [[profileladder]]. Related: [[insurance-scr-data]], [[solvency2rfr]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: One-Year Correlated Chain Ladder 是符合 Solvency II 指引的一年期相關鏈梯實現（論文《A bayesian internal model for reserve risk: an extension of the Correlated Chain Ladder》發表於 MDPI Risks 8(4):125）：把相關鏈梯適配到一年期準備金風險視角（Solvency II 的一年期折現與風險邊際）。對 RIAA：Solvency II 準備金風險的一年期方法論文代碼。與 [[chainladder]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]（一年期視角）、[[profileladder]] 互補。關聯 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[solvency2rfr]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
